csv_scope_of_work: Burke County is seeking an architectural firm or individual architect to provide architectural and design services for its Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) application. The award of the architectural contract for this project is contingent upon the grant being funded by the Georgia Department of Community Affairs. Responding firms should be technically qualified and licensed to provide the design and inspection services for local state and federally funded projects including architectural services and programs.

title: Architectural Services CDBG Program
short_description: Architectural and design services for a CDBG-DR funded local rehabilitation project.
project_scope: Burke County seeks architectural and design services in support of a Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) application. The notice indicates local, state, and federally funded project design and inspection services, with requested disciplines including architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering. No specific building type, size, gross floor area, or technical structural characteristics are stated.
services: Architectural services, design services, inspection services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering support related to the CDBG-DR application and subsequent project if funded.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an architectural services procurement for a grant-funded local building project.
- No defined structural scope, span, size, or technically demanding load-bearing structure is described.
- Requested disciplines are broad and include architecture and interiors rather than specialized structural engineering.
- Could involve rehabilitation/refurbishment, but no bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure is identified.
- Strategic value for sbp is low due to missing technical complexity and unclear project definition.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the notice. The project is contingent on CDBG-DR grant funding, but the specific facility type, size, and extent of works are not described, so no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the available information.
fee_explanation: No design fee or fee basis is stated. Because the underlying project scope, size, and construction budget are undefined and contingent on grant funding, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be made from the notice alone.
references_qualifications: Responding firms should be technically qualified and licensed to provide design and inspection services for local, state, and federally funded projects, including architectural services and programs.
contracting_authority: Burke County, Georgia. Location: Waynesboro, GA, USA. Contact: Nicee D. Long. Phone: 706-651-7301. Fax: 706-554-0350. Email: nlong@csrarc.ga.gov. Website: https://burkecounty-ga.gov/bid_detail_T6_R328.php
notes: Project funding source noted as DCA. The architectural contract award is contingent upon grant funding by the Georgia Department of Community Affairs. Tender stage is RFP/RFQ. Source does not specify the exact facility, building program, or whether the assignment is limited to grant application support or includes full downstream design services.
